_readme: Locked 2026-11-11 from Dylan's direction: dark fantasy high poly for the hero and the hero's gear (character, equipment); bright kiddie low poly for NPCs, nuisances, environment and effects (npc, terrain_piece, particle_mesh). prefix/suffix are added around every prompt of that --type by meshy.py and rodin.py. Keep the style words identical within a type; adjust once after the first test asset per type, then leave them.
